entities.summary: Christopher Simpson (1602/1606–1669) was an English musician and composer, particularly associated with music for the viola da gamba. Christopher Simpson was a heads of state & government (1606–1669-07-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
